item.description:
## Reports - Added a **Reports** page with your weekly report (Saturday to Friday): scrobbles compared with the previous week, your top artist, album and track, and the new artists, albums and tracks you discovered.
## Notifications - Get notified every 5,000 scrobbles, when you discover a new artist, and when your weekly report is ready every Friday at 16:00 Central European Time. Clicking a notification opens the matching page. - Turn each one on or off in **Preferences → General → Notifications**.
## Profile - Choose the period for your top artists, albums and tracks: last 7 days, 30 days, 365 days or all time. - **See more** opens a window with your top 50 for that chart and period.
## Now Playing - Added animated album covers, with an option to prioritize fetching them.
## Scrobbles - Shows what you're playing on another device, according to last.fm, and refreshes every 30 seconds while open.
## Friends - Fixed friends always showing no recent listening. Each friend now shows their latest scrobble and whether they're listening right now.
## Settings - Added **Remove “(feat.)” and “(with)” from song titles**. - Added **Include (Apple Music Edition)** to the album suffix cleanup.
## Other - The session key is no longer sent in request URLs. - scrap remembers the page you were on.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/swagdotsh/scrap/compare/v1.6...v1.7

## Now Playing - Added a heart beside the track name showing whether it is loved on last.fm. Click it to love or unlove the track without changing Apple Music favorites.
## Settings - Added **Love favorited songs (Apple Music)** to automatically love the current song on last.fm when it is favorited in Apple Music, including favorites added during playback.
## Menu bar - The scrap popup now closes when you click outside it, including clicks in other scrap windows.
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/swagdotsh/scrap/compare/v1.5...v1.6

scrap 1.5
Now Playing - See exactly how artist and album names will be scrobbled when the first-artist or album-suffix cleanup options change them. - Listening counts, artist biographies, top songs, and top albums now follow the first-artist setting and refresh when it changes.
Settings - Added examples for the first-artist and album-suffix cleanup options. - Added an editable “Keep these artist names intact” list, with Earth, Wind & Fire included by default, to protect band names containing commas or ampersands.
Menu bar - “Love track” now uses a native checkmark to show whether a track is loved. Select it to toggle love status. - “Share track” now opens the native macOS sharing picker with the track’s last.fm link.
